study_identification_part.si4_title: Rightward brain structural asymmetry in young children with autism

study_characteristics_part.sc1_study_objective: Using developmental normative models on sMRI, characterize atypical gray matter volume (GMV) asymmetry in young children with ASD with/without DD/ID and DD/ID-only, and test associations with behavioral/clinical measures and gene expression profiles.

rci2_hc_n.reason: The paper states that 219 typically developing children were included in the dataset after quality control. However, only 247 TDs were used for training the normative models based on the statistical analysis section. The discrepancy suggests that some holdout was used, but the main HC sample size after QC is 219.
rci2_hc_n.supporting_text: After imaging quality control (see below for details), the data of 1030 young children were employed for analysis, including ... 219 age-matched TD children (4.42 ± 1.62 years, range from 1.17 to 7 years, 107 males). ... GPR models of GMV asymmetry for each ROI were trained based on 247 TDs with age and sex as covariates.
rci2_hc_n.location: Geng2025.pdf.md: Methods / Participants, L41; Methods / Statistical and normative modelling analysis, L59

rci4_hc_sex.reason: The paper states 107 males out of 219 TD children. Female count is calculated as 219 - 107 = 112. Percentages were calculated: M = 107/219 * 100 = 48.9%; F = 112/219 * 100 = 51.1%. This is confirmed by Supplementary Table S2 showing 48.9% male.

rci5_imaging_modality.supporting_text: Similar T1-weighted axial protocols were employed for structural MRI data collection.

rci9_site_effect_handling.detail: ComBat harmonization using empirical Bayes approach; Applied after preprocessing to harmonize site effects; Two sites (Philips Ingenia at Site 1, Siemens Verio at Site 2)
rci9_site_effect_handling.supporting_text: The ComBat analysis based on an empirical Bayes approach was utilized to harmonize the site effects. ... The MRI data of 283 children (164 ASD with DD/ID, 74 ASD without DD/ID, and 45 TD) were collected at site 1 with a Philips Ingenia MRI scanner. And MRI data of 747 children (399 ASD with DD/ID, 138 ASD without DD/ID, 36 DD/ID, and 174 TD) were collected at site 2 with a Siemens Verio MRI scanner.

caa1_clinical_dataset.reason: The clinical groups were from the same dataset as the healthy controls. All participants were recruited from the Shanghai Autism Early Development Cohort.
caa1_clinical_dataset.supporting_text: Participants were recruited from a neurodevelopmental project - Shanghai Autism Early Development Cohort. All children were recruited from those who had visited the Department of Developmental Behaviour and Children Health Care, Xinhua Hospital, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, due to concerns of linguistic and/or social deficits and were assessed for early signs of autism.

clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa8_key_findings_brief: ASD children show rightward GMV asymmetry in inferior parietal and precentral regions; ASD+DD/ID exhibits broader mean deviations; ASD-only shows elevated heterogeneity; DD/ID-only shows no significant asymmetry abnormalities.
